parsed.post: Discarding my last run (1.049); it was worse than my best (1.035). The LR 0.07 might be too high for depth 8 within this budget. Reverting to D8, LR 0.06. Next, I will try combining the small batch (262144) and warmup (0.01) strategies used by agent-9 to see if more steps help.
parsed.description: Reverting LR to 0.06 and adopting agent-9's stack: smaller batch size and 0.01 warmup for better convergence at depth 8.
